questions.stem: Mrs. Bishnoi, a 36-year-old female, visits the hospital complaining of irritability, nervousness, and panic. She was diagnosed with hypertension by her local doctor due to persistent increased BP records. She also reports that she has chronic constipation and heat intolerance. She feels more heat than others and also has increased sweating. Her abdominal CT scan shows a tumor. Where should this tumor lie according to her symptoms?
questions.solutionHtml:
Adrenal medulla
  • The adrenal medulla secretes epinephrine and norepinephrine in response to sympathetic nervous system stimulation. A tumor here called pheochromocytoma can produce uncontrolled secretions of catecholamines and therefore increases the sympathetic innervation of all organ systems, which causes signs and symptoms the patient is suffering from. So, option D is correct.



Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th Edition Page no 78

questions.stem: Most peptide and protein hormones are synthesized as:
questions.solutionHtml:
A preprohormone
  • Like other polypeptide hormones and related proteins that enter the endoplasmic reticulum, insulin is synthesized as part of a larger preprohormone



Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 281,317.

questions.stem: A patient complains of hydruria (7 liters per day) and polydipsia. Examination reveals no disorders of carbohydrate metabolism. These abnormalities might be caused by the dysfunction of the following endocrine gland:
questions.solutionHtml:
Neurohypophysis

Hydruria and polydipsia in case of no disorders of carbohydrate metabolism are the symptoms of diabetes insipidus – the disease caused by a deficiency of antidiuretic hormone secreted by neurohypophysis.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page Number:941, 948 & 950.

questions.stem: An experimental animal is instrumented to monitor plasma glucose and insulin levels. After a control fasting period to establish a steady state, a test substance is administered to the animal. Shortly after the administration of the substance, there is an increase in the plasma insulin concentration and a fall in the plasma glucose concentration. Which of the following is the most likely substance?
questions.solutionHtml:
A Sulfonylurea Compound

The correct answer is a sulfonylurea compound. These compounds block the ATP-inhabitable K+ channel in the beta cells, which causes depolarization and activation of a Ca2+ channel. The influx of Ca2+ stimulates insulin secretion.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page Number:983-995.

questions.stem: Growth hormone level is decreased in which of the following conditions?
questions.solutionHtml:
REM Sleep

Growth hormone(GH) level is decreased during deep sleep. Specifically, it is reduced during REM sleep.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page Number: 995.

questions.stem: Sodium-iodide symporter is absent in which of the following sites?
questions.solutionHtml:
Pituitary

Sodium-iodide symporter is absent in the pituitary.




Ganong's Review Of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition Page no: 357
